cells.name: Continuity and responsiveness
cells.example: T4 answers T3's externals point; T7 answers T5; T8 answers T7's reading-time mitigation.
cells.limitation: Stoic turns T6 and T9 answer no prior turn; rigid rotation reads as parallel monologues.

cells.name: Development of ideas
cells.example: T8 adds traffic variance as a new cost beyond the opening positions.
cells.limitation: T8's variance distinction is never used by a later turn; T6 restates T3.

cells.name: Exploration of central tensions
cells.example: Money versus time and adaptation (T2, T5, T7) are examined.
cells.limitation: Nobody raises current commute length, remote days, career growth or commute mode.

cells.name: Integration of perspectives
cells.example: T4 reframes the Stoic externals claim as affecting internal state.
cells.limitation: No view is reshaped by another; T9 splits the difference into two value paths.

cells.name: Progress toward understanding
cells.example: Section E sharpens toward financial stress and an effective hourly rate.
cells.limitation: T9 ends where T3 began; section D's outsourcing dispute never appeared in the debate.

cells.name: Faithful engagement
cells.example: T7 states the strongest utilitarian case: commute time usable for reading or rest.
cells.limitation: T5 dismisses T4's debt-and-family case as a common trap without engaging it.

cells.name: Substance of challenges
cells.example: T7 tests T5's assumption that the commute is pure suffering.
cells.limitation: T5 never answers T4's debt relief point; no objection names what breaks if false.

cells.name: Accuracy and support
cells.example: T1 faithfully renders Bentham's opening on pain and pleasure.
cells.limitation: T5 states non-adaptation as certainty; T8 invents highway traffic; T6 line sounds Senecan (suspected).

cells.name: Calibration and transparency
cells.example: T7 frames mitigation conditionally: if the commute allows reading.
cells.limitation: T2 asserts the user suffers a focusing illusion; T5 says your brain will not adapt.

cells.name: Intellectual honesty and revision
cells.example: T8 partly accepts T7's productivity premise before countering.
cells.limitation: No mind concedes or revises anything across nine turns.

cells.name: Identification of the actual concern
cells.example: Section A frames raise against daily three-hour drain as the core tension.
cells.limitation: User asked how to decide; no turn asks what is pulling them toward the offer.

cells.name: Meaningful use of personal context
cells.example: T1 names three hours in transit from the stated 90 minutes each way.
cells.limitation: The 25 percent and 90 minutes are never computed against each other in any turn.

cells.name: Fit with goals and values
cells.example: T9 offers resources versus time as the user's own choice.
cells.limitation: User's priorities never asked; Stoic T6 imposes its own valuation of time.

cells.name: Attention to constraints and stakes
cells.example: T4 conditions on debt or a family as stakes that change the calculation.
cells.limitation: T8 invents highway driving; T8 assumes current life is stable and predictable.

cells.name: Responsiveness to information
cells.example: Section E branches on financial stress versus a stable situation.
cells.limitation: Commute mode, current commute, remote options never asked or branched.

cells.name: Clarification of desires and motivations
cells.example: T3 asks whether the work itself aligns with the user's character.
cells.limitation: T2 declares a focusing illusion as fact; no alternative motives offered.

cells.name: Examination of assumptions
cells.example: T7 surfaces the assumption that commuting time is pure suffering.
cells.limitation: The take-or-stay binary and the money-happiness link go unexamined as assumptions.

cells.name: Clarification of values and priorities
cells.example: T9 contrasts expanding resources with the integrity of one's own time.
cells.limitation: The conflict is named, not worked through; no weighting question for the user.

cells.name: Recognition of fears and outside expectations
cells.example: T4 names the pain of debt and providing for a family.
cells.limitation: Fear, obligation and social pressure around a raise are otherwise absent.

cells.name: Agency and reflective ownership
cells.example: T9: the decision is yours, not the salary's.
cells.limitation: Offered distinctions are binary verdict paths, little the user can refine.

cells.name: Definition of the decision and options
cells.example: T9 defines take the path versus stay where you are.
cells.limitation: Negotiating remote days, relocating, a trial period or waiting never appear.

cells.name: Explanation of tradeoffs
cells.example: T8 names variance cost; T4 names financial security benefit.
cells.limitation: Staying is treated as costless; no turn names what the current job costs.

cells.name: Identification of decisive conditions
cells.example: Section E: financial stress favours the raise; stable life favours staying.
cells.limitation: Significant stress has no observable threshold; hourly rate given no comparison point.

cells.name: Treatment of uncertainty
cells.example: T8 treats traffic unpredictability as a source of variance.
cells.limitation: Consequential unknowns like commute mode and current commute not separated from minor ones.

cells.name: Proportionate next steps
cells.example: Section E: calculate effective hourly wage after three daily commute hours.
cells.limitation: One calculation only; no limited step such as asking about hybrid days.

cells.name: Accessible language
cells.example: T6: trade three hours of your life every day for paper currency.
cells.limitation: T5 negative stimulus and T8 cognitive load lean on jargon.

cells.name: Traceable arguments and references
cells.example: T4 Externalities matter clearly picks up T3's externals claim.
cells.limitation: T5 That is a common trap is ambiguous; section D cites unraised outsourcing.

cells.name: Manageable pacing and turn length
cells.example: Nine turns, all within word range per deterministic checks.
cells.limitation: Near-identical turn lengths T1 to T9 make the rhythm monotonous.

cells.name: Distinguishable positions and voices
cells.example: Three lenses distinct in content: calculation, bias, inner integrity.
cells.limitation: Uniform lecturing register across all minds; no explicit position change.

cells.name: Economy and sustained attention
cells.example: Most turns add one point without recapping the previous speaker.
cells.limitation: T6 restates T3's selling-your-life point with little new.

cells.name: Meaningful stakes and tension
cells.example: T3: merely selling your life for a higher price.
cells.limitation: Stakes stay abstract; no concrete day, person or cost made vivid.

cells.name: Surprise and reversals
cells.example: T7 briefly turns the commute from pain into reading time.
cells.limitation: No mind reverses or shifts across nine turns.

cells.name: Personality and expressive voice
cells.example: T1 Bentham's two sovereign masters gives the Utilitarian a recognisable voice.
cells.limitation: Behavioral Economist and Stoic speak in the same flat admonishing register.

cells.name: Memorable delivery
cells.example: T3 selling your life for a higher price is a sharp line.
cells.limitation: Few analogies or examples; T8 highway image is generic.

cells.name: Anticipation and emotional movement
cells.example: T1 opens with a question the debate sets out to answer.
cells.limitation: Constant even intensity; predictable rotation; T9 resolves into a neutral split.

strengths: Section E offers a concrete, user-runnable step: effective hourly wage after commute time.
T7 and T8 form a genuine exchange testing whether commute time is pure loss.
Three lenses (Utilitarian, Behavioral Economist, Stoic) are distinct in content from T1 to T3.
weaknesses: No mind concedes, revises or reverses across nine turns; T5 ignores T4's debt case.
Key facts (commute mode, current commute, remote options) never asked; T8 invents highway traffic.
Options stay take-or-stay; negotiation, hybrid work or a trial never appear (T9, section E).

symptoms.observed: No mind concedes anything; T5 waves off T4's debt case unanswered.
Commute mode left unasked; T8 assumes driving, contradicting T7's reading scenario.
symptoms.evidence: your happiness depends on the highway conditions

symptoms.observed: Only take or stay defined; no negotiation, hybrid or limited trial option.
symptoms.evidence: take the path. If you value the integrity

symptoms.observed: User's bias and future non-adaptation stated as fact, not hypothesis.
symptoms.evidence: You are suffering from a focusing illusion.

symptoms.observed: Positions at T9 match openings; nothing changes any mind.
symptoms.evidence: Ultimately, the choice depends on where you place your value.

findings.description: Asserts the user is suffering a focusing illusion with no evidence from the user's message.
Commuting non-adaptation finding (associated with Stutzer and Frey) stated as certainty and attached to Kahneman's book.
Assumes the commute is by car on a highway and that current life is stable; user said neither.
Time is the only thing we truly possess sounds closer to Seneca's letters than Meditations.
Names outsourcing household labor as the remaining dispute, though no turn raised it.

rubric_fit_notes: User supplied only two facts, so personal-relevance cells depend heavily on whether the debate asked for more; it largely did not. Suspected attribution issues rest on memory only.
question_type_note: Decision question, so every cell was read as written, with options and decisive conditions weighed for a take-or-decline choice.
